ProgramUnit.Name: POPULATE_PARM_SELECT
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE populate_parm_select IS
CURSOR parm_cur IS
 select distinct parm_no,appl_id,report_name,user_name,parm_id,parm_code 
 from rpt_parm_select 
 where
 appl_id = :rpt_parm.appl_id and
 report_name = :rpt_parm.report_name and
 user_name = :rpt_parm.user_name and
 parm_id = :rpt_parm.parm_id 
 order by parm_no;
rps_rec parm_cur%ROWTYPE; 
l_parm number; 
BEGIN
 :global.rps_parm := 0;
 go_block('rpt_parm_select');
 if :rpt_parm_select.parm_no = NULL then
 null;
 else
 clear_block(no_validate);
 end if;
 
 open parm_cur;
 LOOP
 fetch parm_cur INTO rps_rec;
 EXIT WHEN parm_cur%NOTFOUND;
 
-- go_block('rpt_parm_select');
--message('before create record'); 
 -- create_record;
--message('after create record'|| :system.record_status);

if :system.record_status = 'NEW' 
 then
 null;
 else
 create_record;
end if;
:rpt_parm_select.parm_no := rps_rec.parm_no;
:rpt_parm_select.appl_id := rps_rec.appl_id;
:rpt_parm_select.report_name := rps_rec.report_name;
:rpt_parm_select.user_name := rps_rec.user_name;
:rpt_parm_select.parm_id := rps_rec.parm_id;
:rpt_parm_select.parm_code := rps_rec.parm_code;
select code_desc 
 into :rpt_parm_select.code_desc
 from rpt_parm_code
 where appl_id = :rpt_parm_select.appl_id
 and parm_code = :rpt_parm_select.parm_code;

-- FOR PARM_SELECT parameter

select count(*) into l_parm from rpt_parm_select
 where appl_id = :rpt_parm_select.appl_id and
 user_name = :rpt_parm_select.user_name and
 report_name = :rpt_parm_select.report_name and
 parm_id = :rpt_parm_select.parm_id and
 parm_no = :rpt_parm_select.parm_no and 
 parm_code = :rpt_parm_select.parm_code;
:global.rps_parm := l_parm;
if l_parm = 1 then
select parm_select into :rpt_parm_select.parm_select from rpt_parm_select
 where appl_id = :rpt_parm_select.appl_id and
 user_name = :rpt_parm_select.user_name and
 report_name = :rpt_parm_select.report_name and
 parm_id = :rpt_parm_select.parm_id and
 parm_no = :rpt_parm_select.parm_no and 
 parm_code = :rpt_parm_select.parm_code;
else
select parm_select into :rpt_parm_select.parm_select from rpt_parm_select
 where appl_id = :rpt_parm_select.appl_id and
 user_name = :rpt_parm_select.user_name and
 report_name = :rpt_parm_select.report_name and
 parm_id = :rpt_parm_select.parm_id and
 parm_no = :rpt_parm_select.parm_no and 
 parm_code = :rpt_parm_select.parm_code and rownum<2;
 :rpt_parm_select.parm_select := :rpt_parm_select.parm_select||' >';
end if;


-- PARAM_SELECT END

 END LOOP;
close parm_cur;
first_record;
go_field('rpt_parm.report_name');
 return;
END populate_parm_select;

ProgramUnit.Name: RUN_OTHERFORM
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE RUN_OTHERFORM (p_name in varchar2 , P_type in varchar2 )IS
p_exec_name varchar2(12);
author varchar2(10);
module_name varchar2(200);
mnemonic_name varchar2(8);

BEGIN
 
 if p_type = 'M' then
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select A.exec_name, b.descrip into
 p_exec_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 b.mnemonic = p_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;

 if p_type = 'X' then
 p_exec_name := p_name;
 mnemonic_name := p_name;
 select b.mnemonic, b.descrip into
 mnemonic_name, module_name
 from fcn a, menu_item b
 where a.fcn_id = b.fcn_id and
 a.exec_name = p_exec_name and
 rownum = 1;
 end if;


 if :global.db_id = 'N/A'
 then
 begin
 select
 decode(substr(global_name,1,1),'W','D',substr(global_name,1,3))
 into :global.db_id
 from global_name;
 exception
 when others then handle_error;
 end;
 end if;

 if substr(:global.db_id,1,1) = 'D' Then
 begin
 select Program_author into author from fcn
 where exec_name = p_exec_name ;
 Exception
 When no_data_found then
 author := 'ISQA'; 
 End;
 module_name := module_name ||' By '||author;
 end if;

 p_exec_name := p_exec_name ||'.fmx';
 module_name := mnemonic_name ||': '||
 module_name ;
 :global.module_name := module_name;
 CALL_FORM( lower(p_exec_name));
 if form_failure then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
 end if;
exception
 when no_data_found then
 message ('Err: Module ' || p_exec_name ||
 ' not found, contact systems.');
 bell;
end;
